growth_thesis.basis: Stated in P4; net sales figure matches F2.
growth_thesis.claim: Comparable store sales growth is the main organic driver: Q2 fiscal 2026 net sales rose 7.0% to $4,886.5 million on a 3.7% comp increase plus $225.9 million from non-comparable stores.
quotes: Net sales increased 7.0% to $4,886.5 million primarily due to a 3.7% comparable store net sales increase and net sales of $225.9 million at non-comparable stores.

growth_thesis.claim: The Q2 comp gain came mostly from average ticket, which rose 3.3%, while traffic rose only 0.4%.
quotes: Comparable store net sales growth included a 3.3% increase in average ticket and a 0.4% increase in traffic

growth_thesis.claim: Condition for comp growth to continue: traffic must hold up as prices rise. In fiscal 2025, retail price changes caused traffic to decline in Q3 and Q4.
quotes: As a result of the retail price changes, customer traffic was negatively impacted and declined in the third and fourth quarters of fiscal 2025.
Further, raising the price points of merchandise could cause customers to buy fewer products and affect our competitive position with other retailers.

growth_thesis.claim: The multi-price format rollout is a growth driver. About 710 stores were converted or added in Q2, for approximately 6,600 multi-price stores in total.
quotes: Converted or added about 710 stores to the Dollar Tree multi-price format, ending the quarter with approximately 6,600 multi-price stores

Our multi-price strategy is designed to increase basket size and drive margin expansion by introducing complementary products, new categories, larger pack sizes, and select branded and licensed items that we could not historically offer under a single price point.

growth_thesis.claim: Condition for the multi-price driver: customers must accept the expanded assortment and its value proposition.
quotes: Further, our failure to drive brand clarity and loyalty around our expanded product assortment could negatively affect our customer’s perception of our value proposition or harm our reputation.

growth_thesis.claim: New store growth adds sales. The company opened 188 new stores in the 26 weeks to August 1, 2026 and ended with 9,436 stores.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the P6 store activity table.
